biggest_catch: The $250 is split into two $125 halves with different requirements: $125 needs 5 debit-card transactions within 60 days, and the second $125 needs $1,000/month qualifying direct deposit (or monthly ACH transfer — the ACH-transfer alternative is not clearly defined) posted and cleared; the bonus is forfeited if the account is closed or not in positive balance at payout.
catches: $250 paid as two $125 halves with different requirements.
First $125: 5 debit card transactions within 60 days of opening.

Second $125: $1,000/month qualifying direct deposit or monthly ACH transfer — official page lists an ACH-transfer alternative whose terms are not clearly defined; a qualifying direct deposit is payroll/pension/Social Security/government income from employer or external agency.
Each $125 deposited within 75 days of meeting that part's requirements.
Account must be open with a positive balance at payout or bonus is forfeited.
New customers only: must not have held a Grand Bank checking account within the last 60 days; one bonus per person.
Customers 18+ only; Grand Bank employees ineligible.
BankOn Certified (Basic) checking variant is available only to MS residents (Simple Checking has no stated geographic restriction).
Offer expires October 14, 2026; subject to change.
